description.short_caption: Diffuse papulopustular rash on the back.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the back of an individual with numerous erythematous papules and pustules scattered diffusely across the skin. The lesions vary in size and are distributed without a clear pattern. There is no visible ulceration or crusting. The findings suggest an inflammatory or infectious dermatologic process.

description.short_caption: Erythematous papules and pustules on the chest and upper abdomen.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the anterior chest and upper abdomen of an adult. Multiple erythematous papules and pustules are scattered across the skin, with some lesions appearing to have central crusting. The distribution is diffuse but concentrated on the central chest. The findings suggest an inflammatory or infectious dermatosis.
visible_findings: diffuse distribution on chest and upper abdomen

description.short_caption: Small ulcer with central eschar on the plantar foot.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the plantar surface of a foot with a small, round ulceration. The lesion has a central black eschar surrounded by a rim of erythema. The surrounding skin appears intact, with no overt signs of extensive swelling or drainage. The lesion is well-demarcated and isolated.
